3220-4279-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3220-4279-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2510-2701-7182-7252.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-2701-7182-7252.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Semblance Anvil
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2577-5147-6763-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5147-6763-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

4067-5078-6259-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Samut.
Repeat

2034-4679-6023-7895.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear.
When the Little Bear token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Little Bear token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

215-5457-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-5457-7730.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-5457-7730.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

2092-2757-4991-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Whisperwood Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Whisperwood Elemental, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Whisperwood Elemental by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1978-3941-7329.description:
Animate Coveted Jewel using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-4306-7290.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
1978-4306-7290.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Does Machines.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least three mana of an applicable color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1090-3817.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Stastion trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-7061.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-7061.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

2511-5220-6535-6900.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

339-677-5256-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1562-2829-4375.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Machine God's Effigy enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Machine God's Effigy.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

673-813-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Planar Incision.
673-813-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

856-1808-4231-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cauldron Familiar's power.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1636-2511-2857.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2511-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing it.
When Bloodflow Connoisseur dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Bloodflow Connoisseur from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodflow Connoisseur enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
1636-2511-2857.notes: You may instead target any other nontoken creature you control to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Bloodflow Connoisseur.

203-4050-5851.description:
Cast Anoint with buyback by paying {3}{W}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Anoint, returning it to your hand.
If you control at least eight Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Stormsplitter tokens, adding {3}{W}.
Repeat.

2315-3946-4935.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

787-1170-3923.notablePrerequisites: You control up to four permanents that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
787-1170-3923.description:
Activate up to four permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, untapping up to four permanents.
Repeat.
If the four permanents can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}, you may get infinite mana, and then use Teferi's first loyalty ability instead.

1651-4231-4330.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has fought this turn.
1651-4231-4330.description:
Activate Boxing Ring by tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two of the tokens, untapping Boxing Ring.
Repeat.

2034-4191-4504.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches, adding {C}{C}.
Endless Cockroaches dies, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Endless Cockroaches by paying {0}.
Repeat.

573-1479-4862.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-4862.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Omnath, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Omnath trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

937-3859-4591.description:
During your upkeep, activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Resolve the last Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it to your hand.
The remaining Cavern Harpy triggers fizzle.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
